question: How many days of paid time off do full-time employees get each year?
answer: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid time off per calendar year [1].

question: At what rate does PTO accrue?
answer: PTO accrues monthly at a rate of 1.67 days per month, starting on the first day of employment [1][2].

question: How much unused PTO can I carry over into next year?
answer: Up to 5 days of unused PTO can be carried over into the next year. Any balance above 5 days on December 31 is forfeited. [1]

question: How many paid company holidays are there?
answer: Northwind observes 10 paid company holidays each year. [1]

question: How many days a week can I work from home?
answer: You can work remotely up to 3 days per week, with manager approval [1]. Teams also agree on at least one shared in-office day each week, called the anchor day [1].

question: What are the core collaboration hours?
answer: Core collaboration hours are 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. Eastern Time [1]. During these hours, employees are expected to be reachable on the company chat tool [1].

question: Is there a stipend for setting up a home office?
answer: Yes. Employees working remotely receive a one-time home office stipend of $400, which can be used for a desk, chair, monitor, or other equipment [1].

question: How soon do I need to submit an expense for reimbursement?
answer: Business expenses must be submitted for reimbursement within 30 days of the purchase. [2]

question: Which expenses need manager approval before purchase?
answer: Expenses over $500 require written approval from your manager before the purchase is made. [2]

question: What is the annual learning and development budget?
answer: Each employee has an annual learning budget of $1,500 for courses, books, certifications, and conferences [1].

question: What is the minimum password length?
answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long. [1]

question: Can I use text message codes for multi-factor authentication?
answer: No. Employees must use an authenticator app for MFA, and text message (SMS) codes are not allowed because they can be intercepted [1].

question: My laptop was stolen. What should I do?
answer: If your company laptop is lost or stolen, report it to the IT security team within 1 hour by emailing security@northwind.example [1]. The IT team will remotely lock and erase the device [1]. The policy says reporting quickly matters more than knowing exactly where the device was lost [1].

question: What are the data classification levels?
answer: The data classification levels are Public, Internal, Confidential, and Restricted. [1]

question: What do I need to do before using the airport Wi-Fi for work?
answer: Before accessing any internal system on airport Wi-Fi, you must connect to the company VPN. [2]

question: How long are the zippers on the Trailhead backpack covered?
answer: Zippers and buckles on the Trailhead backpack are covered for 2 years from the date of purchase. [1]

question: How long do I have to return an unused backpack?
answer: You can return an unused Trailhead backpack within 60 days of delivery for a full refund. It must be in its original condition with tags attached [1].

question: When is shipping free?
answer: Shipping within the United States is free on orders over $75. Orders under $75 have a flat $8 shipping fee. [1]

question: How many countries do you ship to, and how long does international delivery take?
answer: Northwind ships internationally to 40 countries [2]. International delivery usually takes 7 to 14 business days [1].

question: What is the capacity of the Trailhead backpack?
answer: The Trailhead backpack has a capacity of 28 liters [1].
